dedupe_keys.name: bilan ppi operations ajoutees au ppi 2017 2026 routes

description: Bilan PPI - Opérations ajoutées au PPI 2017-2026 - Routes is a dataset listed in data.corsica open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Collectivité de Corse. Ce fichier présente les opérations ajoutées a posteriori au Plan pluriannuel des investissements (PPI) 2017–2026 de la Collectivité de Corse, principalement dans le domaine routier. Ces opérations, non prévues initialement, ont été intégrées en cours de période en fonction des priorités techniques, sécuritaires ou stratégiques identifiées. Coverage: Corsica. The portal files it under Transport & Mobility. Its keywords are PPI, Plan pluriannuel des investissements (PPI), Infrastructures. The portal shows 46 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2025-08-04 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-data-corsica-portal.
